propositions: The environment variable scanner recognizes only os.environ.get, os.environ subscript, and os.getenv forms, causing other read patterns like os.environ.pop to be silently omitted from the generated registry.

A refactoring from os.environ.get to os.environ.pop drops the variable from docs/env-vars.md with no diagnostic signal, violating the generator's stated invariant that new env reads cannot ship undocumented.
The local lint gate does not catch stale or incomplete generated registries; only the full CI suite runs the drift check, creating a feedback loop where contributors trust a weak local signal.

The fix classifies all os.environ attribute accesses (get, pop, setdefault, __getitem__) as key-bearing and raises UnrecognisedEnvironAccess for any unrecognized accessor, making the scanner fail-closed rather than silently skipping novel forms.
